items.html: And in the way we explained how the thirty levels of the Nukva are divided and clothed — the inner ten Sefirot in the aspect of a Neshama for the ten Sefirot of the Malchut of Beria, and the middle ten Sefirot in the aspect of a Neshama for the ten Sefirot of the Nukva of Yetzira, and the posterior ten Sefirot in the aspect of a Neshama for the ten Sefirot of the Nukva of Assiya — so in this same manner, the inner nine Sefirot of ZA of Atzilut are clothed in the aspect of a Neshama for the nine Sefirot of ZA of Beria; and the middle nine Sefirot in the aspect of a Neshama for the nine Sefirot of ZA of Yetzira; and the posterior nine Sefirot in the aspect of a Neshama for the nine Sefirot of ZA of Assiya. And all this is in the aspect of Neshama. And afterward there are the aspects of spirits, souls, and garments in ZA of BYA. And it has already been explained above that only the Neshama is the aspect of Elohut, but from the Ruach and onward is the world of separation.
